title: SOURCE_TARGETS blocked: SHOW TABLE STATUS consumes pending stale-read state but contract decides value

analysis: ShowExec.fetchShowTableStatus is a user-visible SHOW statement path, not a hidden helper between two user statements
the path obtains the current session restricted SQL executor and calls ExecRestrictedSQL with ExecOptionUseCurSession plus ExecOptionWithSnapshot(snapshot)

testbed 8220955 confirms behavior: after SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY AS OF TIMESTAMP, SHOW TABLE STATUS consumes the pending state; the following SELECT reads current rows 1,2, while direct SET TRANSACTION followed by SELECT reads stale row 1

this proves the state-ingress schedule is product-feasible, but not whether it is a bug; stale-read design says SET TRANSACTION affects the next interactive transaction or query statement, and SHOW TABLE STATUS may qualify as that next query
source_anchors: pkg/executor/show.go:132-166 ShowExec.Next/fetchAll executes SHOW as the user's statement
pkg/executor/show.go:636-666 fetchShowTableStatus obtains current session restricted SQL executor and uses ExecOptionUseCurSession

payload.why_not_execute_further: A RED/GREEN fix probe would encode a product decision. Until SHOW TABLE STATUS is classified as allowed or disallowed to consume SET TRANSACTION stale-read state, further execution cannot decide bug quality.
payload.next_step: ask/settle stale-read product contract for SHOW statements; continue target-analysis on target.source.dynamic-state-ingress.pkg-infoschema-infoschema.v1 meanwhile
